name: popsicle
headline: Customer Voice & Behavior Prediction: E-commerce
short_description: E-commerce quick prototyping for customer segmentation, sentiment analysis and review processing automation. Includes presentation in video and PowerPoint together with the ERD of the database used. Serves as Business Case example impacting several business units and providing opportunities to improve Customer Success, Sales, Marketing and Supply Chain.
author: DataRaul

sections.overview:
This skill provides a complete MVP for analyzing customer behavior and sales patterns in e-commerce using Python, NLP, and unsupervised learning. It automates customer voice analysis through Natural Language Processing and segments customers using machine learning to identify actionable patterns. The project includes a 10-minute video presentation, PowerPoint deck, and Entity-Relationship Diagram that document the methodology and business case across customer success, sales, marketing, and supply chain functions. Built on anonymized retail e-commerce data, it demonstrates how to extract geographic and revenue insights at postal code level and uncover customer segmentation opportunities within a one-year planning horizon.
Automated customer sentiment analysis from review data
Customer segmentation for targeted marketing campaigns
Geographic revenue analysis by postal code area
Sales behavior prediction for business case development

The database schema includes tables for Customers, Orders, Products, Reviews, and Segments. Relationships are established to link customer data with their purchase history and reviews.
